sources.title: Ling
sources.snippet: Ling-3.0-flash Ling-3.0-flash is the latest-generation cost-effective model in the Ling series, with 124B total parameters, 5.1B activated parameters, a native 256K context window extendable up to 1M.

sources.title: GitHub - inclusionAI/Ling: Ling is a MoE LLM provided and open-sourced ...
sources.snippet: Ling is a MoE LLM provided and open-sourced by InclusionAI. We introduce two different sizes, which are Ling-lite and Ling-plus. Ling-lite has 16.8 billion parameters with 2.75 billion activated parameters, while Ling-plus has 290 billion parameters with 28.8 billion activated parameters.
